description: M15 candidate question pairs, authored in one pass BEFORE any prompt-v3 text exists and before any model call on them. P is a question with a false or unsupported premise about Flask; Q is its matched twin with a true premise about the real nearby feature. Subtypes: S1 feature Flask lacks, no related code; S2 topical decoy (related code exists but is not the asked-for thing); S3 false presupposition inside a real topic. Automated checks (app/evaluation/check_m15_pairs.py) accept or reject each pair; the first 8 passing per subtype become the test set, the next 3/3/2 the dev set. Nobody tunes a question after seeing a result.
